name: MaxAPY Finance
rootCause: A Rug Pull occurred in MaxAPY Finance, an automatic pledge protocol on BNB Chain, and its official Twitter account and Telegram group have been deleted. MaxAPY contract owners have transferred 1,042 BNB.
